question: How should the mantra of the fifty mātṛkās be recited?
premises: The mantra of the fifty mātṛkās is specified.
The recitation is to be done tenfold.
inference: One should recite the mantra of the fifty mātṛkās tenfold.
plain_english: O beloved, one should recite the mantra of the fifty mātṛkās tenfold.
